headline: Skyrizi + Rinvoq lead · Apogee deal announced
summary_short: AbbVie's Q2 2026 revenue of $17.0B rose 10.2% y/y as Skyrizi and Rinvoq more than offset the Humira biosimilar erosion. Adjusted EPS of $3.65 grew 22.9%. Company announced the Apogee Therapeutics acquisition and tightened FY guidance.
summary_long: Immunology, the anchor franchise, delivered $8.79B (+15.1%) with Skyrizi ($5.51B, +24.4%) and Rinvoq ($2.53B, +24.5%) both accelerating while Humira continued its biosimilar-driven decline to $756M (-35.9%). Neuroscience portfolio surged 20.3% to $3.23B on Vraylar, Botox Therapeutic, Ubrelvy, and Qulipta strength. Oncology dipped 1.5% as Imbruvica erosion (-29.4%) outweighed Venclexta (+11.6%) and Elahere (+33.1%). Aesthetics roughly flat on lower elective demand. GAAP EPS of $2.03 vs $0.52 prior on lapping year-ago IPR&D charges. Company announced the definitive agreement to acquire Apogee Therapeutics (immunology bolt-on, expected Q3 close). FY2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance updated to $13.87-$14.07 (from $13.91-$14.11) reflecting a $0.14 dilutive impact from the Apogee deal.

drivers.explanation: Immunology growth from Skyrizi (+24.4%) and Rinvoq (+24.5%) and Neuroscience portfolio +20.3% more than offset Humira -35.9% biosimilar erosion.
Q2 2025 comparison included large IPR&D and milestone charges; Q2 2026 IPR&D expense is only $0.17/share unfavorable, driving the 290% headline growth.
Imbruvica -29.4% biosimilar/CLL market erosion outweighed Venclexta +11.6% and Elahere +33.1% growth.

confidence_notes: Filing-based summary from Exhibit 99.1 of the July 31 2026 8-K. Product-level y/y deltas quoted directly on reported basis. Operational (constant-currency) figures also disclosed but consistent with reported for major products. Adjusted EPS is a non-GAAP measure. FY2026 EPS guidance updated to $13.87-$14.07.
